record.what_it_does: Aircall is a cloud-based business phone system and call center platform with a REST API and webhooks for managing calls, contacts, users, and messages.
record.auth_notes: Basic Auth (api_id + api_token, Base64-encoded in the Authorization header) is for a customer connecting their own Aircall account only. OAuth2 is required to build an app that serves multiple Aircall customers, and is explicitly tied to becoming an approved Technology Partner listed on Aircall's Marketplace.
record.access_notes: Basic Auth API keys are self-serve from the dashboard, but only for existing Aircall account holders — Aircall has no free plan (7-day free trial only, then paid plans starting ~$30/user/month with a 3-seat minimum). The OAuth2 path needed for a multi-tenant agent toolkit additionally requires signing up as, and being approved as, an Aircall Technology Partner.
record.main_blocker: OAuth2 (needed for a multi-tenant toolkit) requires Aircall Technology Partner approval; base accounts also require a paid plan (only a 7-day free trial, no free tier).
